name: ecfr-regulation-analyzer
description: eCFR Regulation Analyzer - Federal regulation analytics for deregulation decision-making
author: Loc Le

scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.deploy:backend: cd backend && make deploy ENV=${ENV:-dev} REGION=${REGION:-us-west-1}
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean && cd frontend && rm -rf dist node_modules
